- the architecture Canonical File References, File list, Logic Analysis, and Task list must use exactly these files and no substitutes: requirements.txt, tank_battle/directions.py, tank_battle/geometry.py, tank_battle/obstacle.py, tank_battle/arena.py, tank_battle/tank.py, tank_battle/projectile.py, tank_battle/commands.py, tank_battle/scoring.py, tank_battle/game.py, tank_battle/configs.py, tank_battle/__init__.py, Main.py, tests/test_main.py; tank_battle/direction.py, tank_battle/entities.py, tank_battle/scoreboard.py, tank_battle/demo.py, and any combined or renamed substitute are forbidden

- Direction is defined only in tank_battle/directions.py with the literal skeleton `from enum import Enum`, `class Direction(Enum):`, `N=(0,-1)`, `E=(1,0)`, `S=(0,1)`, and `W=(-1,0)`; delta(self)->tuple[int,int] returns self.value, left()->Direction and right()->Direction return enum members, and all movement/barrel/projectile code uses delta rather than duplicate mappings; a plain class whose members are strings or post-construction singleton objects is forbidden
- Rect is an immutable value with Rect(x:int,y:int,w:int,h:int), rejects nonpositive w/h, and contains(px,py) uses half-open cells x<=px<x+w and y<=py<y+h; Obstacle contains one Rect; Arena(width:int,height:int,obstacles:list[Obstacle]) rejects nonpositive dimensions and exposes in_bounds(x,y) and is_blocked(x,y), where out-of-bounds and obstacle cells are blocked
- Tank has the exact constructor Tank(id:str,name:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,health:int=3,speed:int=1), public attributes with the name direction (never dir), barrel_ahead() using direction.delta(), alive(), and clone(); Projectile uses Projectile(pid:int,owner_id:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,speed:int=1), the attribute name direction, move(), and clone()
- Command is an instantiable marker class with no ABC inheritance, no @abstractmethod, and no execute method; its concrete MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, and Fire subclasses also define no execute method
- Game.tick dispatches commands itself solely with isinstance(command, MoveForward/RotateLeft/RotateRight/RotateTo/Fire); command.execute(...) and every other polymorphic command-execution callback are forbidden; MoveForward(steps:int=1) rejects steps<1, RotateLeft/RotateRight/Fire take no arguments, and RotateTo(direction:Direction) stores the attribute direction
- the canonical Game constructor is Game(arena:Arena,tanks:dict[str,Tank]); it validates unique in-bounds unblocked tank cells, deep-copies and stores an immutable initial arena/tank snapshot, and exposes public arena, tanks, projectiles, scores, command_queue, next_projectile_id plus queue_command(player_id,command), tick(), reset(), winner(), and snapshot()
- deterministic tick order is exact: stable-sort queued commands by player id, apply them, clear the queue, then process projectiles by pid; MoveForward attempts one cell at a time and stops before bounds, obstacle, or another live tank; Fire spawns at barrel_ahead if that cell is free, then every projectile including a newly spawned one moves by its speed during that same tick; after each unit step it despawns on bounds/obstacle or hits the first non-owner live tank at that cell, deals exactly one health, records exactly one hit and one kill only if health becomes zero, and is removed
- reset must restore deep clones of the constructor-supplied initial arena and every initial tank including position, direction, health, and speed; it also clears projectiles and command_queue, recreates zeroed scores, and sets next_projectile_id=0; merely clearing projectiles/scores while leaving moved or damaged tanks unchanged is forbidden
- ScoreBoard has the exact constructor `ScoreBoard(player_ids:list[str])`, immediately initializes both hits and kills as `{player_id:0 for player_id in player_ids}`, exposes record_hit, record_kill, and score(player_id)=hits+5*kills; Game construction and reset each use `ScoreBoard(list(self._initial_tanks))`, so zero-hit and zero-kill entries such as kills["p1"] always exist; winner returns one surviving tank id only when at least two tanks were initially supplied and exactly one remains alive, otherwise None
- tank_battle/game.py directly imports every command class it dispatches with the literal line `from .commands import Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire`; importing only Command and then referencing undeclared subclasses is forbidden, and the six mutable public attributes arena, tanks, projectiles, scores, command_queue, and next_projectile_id must be ordinary assignable attributes rather than getter-only properties
- Fire first creates a projectile at barrel_ahead, then the same tick's projectile phase moves every projectile including that new projectile by speed one cell at a time; in the exact hit fixture, tick one therefore leaves it at (3,2), and tick two moves it to (4,2) and hits p2; a test expecting (2,2) after tick one is forbidden
- on a hit, game.py must literally call `self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id)` and, only when health becomes zero, `self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id)`; passing the hit tank id, target id, Tank object, or any other value is forbidden

{"Implementation approach":"Bob (Architect) designs a concise, medium-size Python 3.10 repository for a deterministic Tank battle game. Preserve protocol files exactly and keep Main.py thin. All reusable logic lives in a lowercase snake_case package tank_battle. Imports are acyclic: foundational modules (directions, geometry, obstacle) do not import engines or entrypoints. Snapshot returns plain dict/list/scalars with Direction serialized via .name. Deterministic Game.tick applies queued commands with isinstance dispatch only, then moves projectiles in order during the same tick; reset restores deep initial clones and zeroed ScoreBoard with next_projectile_id=0.

Full API specification (literal, exhaustive and aligned to the non-negotiable checklist):
- Module tank_battle/directions.py:
  - from enum import Enum; class Direction(Enum): with enum members exactly: N=(0,-1), E=(1,0), S=(0,1), W=(-1,0).
  - Methods: delta(self)->tuple[int,int] returns self.value; left(self)->Direction returns enum member; right(self)->Direction returns enum member.
- Module tank_battle/geometry.py:
  - Class Rect(x:int,y:int,w:int,h:int): immutable value; raises ValueError if w<=0 or h<=0; method contains(px:int,py:int)->bool uses half-open cells x<=px<x+w and y<=py<y+h.
- Module tank_battle/obstacle.py:
  - Class Obstacle(rect:Rect) encapsulating one Rect. Provides its rect.
- Module tank_battle/arena.py:
  - Class Arena(width:int,height:int,obstacles:list[Obstacle]) rejects nonpositive dimensions; methods: in_bounds(x:int,y:int)->bool; is_blocked(x:int,y:int)->bool where out-of-bounds and any Obstacle cell are blocked.
- Module tank_battle/tank.py:
  - Class Tank(id:str,name:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,health:int=3,speed:int=1). Public attributes include direction.
  - Methods: barrel_ahead()->tuple[int,int] using direction.delta(); alive()->bool; clone()->Tank deep copy.
- Module tank_battle/projectile.py:
  - Class Projectile(pid:int,owner_id:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,speed:int=1) with attribute direction.
  - Methods: move()->None advances one unit using direction.delta(); clone()->Projectile deep copy.
- Module tank_battle/commands.py:
  - Class Command: instantiable marker; Command has no execute method; no ABC and no @abstractmethod.
  - Subclasses: MoveForward(steps:int=1) rejects steps<1; RotateLeft(); RotateRight(); RotateTo(direction:Direction) stores attribute direction; Fire(). None defines execute.
- Module tank_battle/scoring.py:
  - Class ScoreBoard(player_ids:list[str]) immediately initializes hits and kills as {player_id:0 for player_id in player_ids}.
  - Methods: record_hit(player_id:str)->None; record_kill(player_id:str)->None; score(player_id:str)->int defined as score(player_id)=hits+5*kills.
- Module tank_battle/game.py:
  - Must literally include the import line: from .commands import Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire
  - Class Game(arena:Arena,tanks:dict[str,Tank]) validates unique in-bounds unblocked tank cells; deep-copies and stores an immutable initial arena/tank snapshot.
  - Public mutable attributes: arena, tanks, projectiles, scores, command_queue, next_projectile_id.
  - Methods:
    - queue_command(self, player_id:str, command:Command)->None: enqueue without reordering.
    - tick(self)->None: deterministic order: stable-sort queued commands by player id; dispatch solely with isinstance(command, MoveForward/RotateLeft/RotateRight/RotateTo/Fire); apply; clear queue; then process projectiles by pid ascending. MoveForward attempts one cell at a time and stops before bounds, obstacle, or a live tank. On Fire, if barrel_ahead is free, spawn a new Projectile at that cell with owner_id:str equal to the queuing tank id and pid=self.next_projectile_id then increment; in the same tick's projectile phase, every projectile including the new one moves by its speed one cell at a time; after each unit step, despawn on bounds/obstacle or if hitting the first non-owner live tank at that cell, reduce health by 1, call self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id) and, only when health becomes zero, call self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id), then remove the projectile.
    - reset(self)->None: restore deep clones of the constructor-supplied initial arena and tanks (position, direction, health, speed), clear projectiles and command_queue, set scores=ScoreBoard(list(self._initial_tanks)), and next_projectile_id=0.
    - winner(self)->str|None: returns the sole surviving tank id only when exactly one remains alive from at least two initial tanks; else None.
    - snapshot(self)->dict: returns only plain dict/list/scalars; arena as dict, tanks as dict of dicts with direction serialized via .name, projectiles similarly, scores as a dict with hits, kills, and per-player score mapping, and winner as scalar id or None.
- Module tank_battle/configs.py:
  - build_default_demo()->Game: constructs exactly Arena(8,5,[]) and two tanks: Tank("p1","P1",1,2,Direction.E,3,1) and Tank("p2","P2",6,2,Direction.W,3,1); builds Game and returns it.
- Module tank_battle/__init__.py:
  - Explicitly import and re-export exactly these public symbols: Game, Arena, Obstacle, Rect, Tank, Projectile, ScoreBoard, Direction, Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire, and build_default_demo; __all__ lists those exact names; no wildcard imports and no nested aliases such as Game.Arena; no package attribute named commands.
- Module Main.py:
  - from tank_battle import build_default_demo, RotateRight
  - Function run_demo()->dict: constructs game=build_default_demo(); literally calls game.queue_command("p1", RotateRight()) with a command instance (not the string "RotateRight"), then calls game.tick() exactly once, returns game.snapshot(). main() prints that snapshot and is called under if __name__=="__main__".

Deterministic fixtures (repeat verbatim):
- Arena(8,5,[])
- Tank("p1","P1",1,2,Direction.E,3,1)
- Tank("p2","P2",6,2,Direction.W,3,1)

Projectile same-tick movement rule: Fire first creates a projectile at barrel_ahead; tick one therefore leaves it at (3,2); tick two moves it to (4,2) and hits p2. A test expecting (2,2) after tick one is forbidden.

Scoring call literals: self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id) and self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id) on kill only.

Winner rule: winner returns the sole surviving tank id only when exactly one remains alive from at least two initial tanks.

Reset fixture rule: capture initial snapshot immediately after Game construction with no queued Fire and no tick; after manipulating state, reset() must restore deep clones and zeroed scores as {"p1":0,"p2":0}; next_projectile_id==0.

Import graph policy: foundational modules never import engines or entrypoints; game.py directly imports command classes via the literal line; __init__.py only re-exports public symbols; Main.py imports only build_default_demo and RotateRight.

Snapshot returns plain dict/list/scalars with Direction serialized via .name. Deterministic Game.tick applies queued commands with isinstance dispatch only, then moves projectiles in order during the same tick; reset restores deep initial clones and zeroed ScoreBoard with next_projectile_id=0.\n\nFull API specification (literal, exhaustive and aligned to the non-negotiable checklist):\n- Module tank_battle/directions.py:\n  - from enum import Enum; class Direction(Enum): with enum members exactly: N=(0,-1), E=(1,0), S=(0,1), W=(-1,0).\n  - Methods: delta(self)->tuple[int,int] returns self.value; left(self)->Direction returns enum member; right(self)->Direction returns enum member.\n- Module tank_battle/geometry.py:\n  - Class Rect(x:int,y:int,w:int,h:int): immutable value; raises ValueError if w<=0 or h<=0; method contains(px:int,py:int)->bool uses half-open cells x<=px<x+w and y<=py<y+h.\n- Module tank_battle/obstacle.py:\n  - Class Obstacle(rect:Rect) encapsulating one Rect. Provides its rect.\n- Module tank_battle/arena.py:\n  - Class Arena(width:int,height:int,obstacles:list[Obstacle]) rejects nonpositive dimensions; methods: in_bounds(x:int,y:int)->bool; is_blocked(x:int,y:int)->bool where out-of-bounds and any Obstacle cell are blocked.\n- Module tank_battle/tank.py:\n  - Class Tank(id:str,name:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,health:int=3,speed:int=1). Public attributes include direction.\n  - Methods: barrel_ahead()->tuple[int,int] using direction.delta(); alive()->bool; clone()->Tank deep copy.\n- Module tank_battle/projectile.py:\n  - Class Projectile(pid:int,owner_id:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,speed:int=1) with attribute direction.\n  - Methods: move()->None advances one unit using direction.delta(); clone()->Projectile deep copy.\n- Module tank_battle/commands.py:\n  - Class Command: instantiable marker; Command has no execute method; no ABC and no @abstractmethod.\n  - Subclasses: MoveForward(steps:int=1) rejects steps<1; RotateLeft(); RotateRight(); RotateTo(direction:Direction) stores attribute direction; Fire(). None defines execute.\n- Module tank_battle/scoring.py:\n  - Class ScoreBoard(player_ids:list[str]) immediately initializes hits and kills as {player_id:0 for player_id in player_ids}.\n  - Methods: record_hit(player_id:str)->None; record_kill(player_id:str)->None; score(player_id:str)->int defined as score(player_id)=hits+5*kills.\n- Module tank_battle/game.py:\n  - Must literally include the import line: from .commands import Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire\n  - Class Game(arena:Arena,tanks:dict[str,Tank]) validates unique in-bounds unblocked tank cells; deep-copies and stores an immutable initial arena/tank snapshot.\n  - Public mutable attributes: arena, tanks, projectiles, scores, command_queue, next_projectile_id.\n  - Methods:\n    - queue_command(self, player_id:str, command:Command)->None: enqueue without reordering.\n    - tick(self)->None: deterministic order: stable-sort queued commands by player id; dispatch solely with isinstance(command, MoveForward/RotateLeft/RotateRight/RotateTo/Fire); apply; clear queue; then process projectiles by pid ascending. MoveForward attempts one cell at a time and stops before bounds, obstacle, or a live tank. On Fire, if barrel_ahead is free, spawn a new Projectile at that cell with owner_id:str equal to the queuing tank id and pid=self.next_projectile_id then increment; in the same tick's projectile phase, every projectile including the new one moves by its speed one cell at a time; after each unit step, despawn on bounds/obstacle or if hitting the first non-owner live tank at that cell, reduce health by 1, call self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id) and, only when health becomes zero, call self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id), then remove the projectile.\n    - reset(self)->None: restore deep clones of the constructor-supplied initial arena and tanks (position, direction, health, speed), clear projectiles and command_queue, set scores=ScoreBoard(list(self._initial_tanks)), and next_projectile_id=0.\n    - winner(self)->str|None: returns the sole surviving tank id only when exactly one remains alive from at least two initial tanks; else None.\n    - snapshot(self)->dict: returns only plain dict/list/scalars; arena as dict, tanks as dict of dicts with direction serialized via .name, projectiles similarly, scores as a dict with hits, kills, and per-player score mapping, and winner as scalar id or None.\n- Module tank_battle/configs.py:\n  - build_default_demo()->Game: constructs exactly Arena(8,5,[]) and two tanks: Tank(\"p1\",\"P1\",1,2,Direction.E,3,1) and Tank(\"p2\",\"P2\",6,2,Direction.W,3,1); tick one therefore leaves it at (3,2); tick two moves it to (4,2) and hits p2. None defines execute.\n- Module tank_battle/scoring.py:\n  - Class ScoreBoard(player_ids:list[str]) immediately initializes hits and kills as {player_id:0 for player_id in player_ids}.\n  - Methods: record_hit(player_id:str)->None; record_kill(player_id:str)->None; score(player_id:str)->int defined as score(player_id)=hits+5*kills.\n- Module tank_battle/game.py:\n  - Must literally include the import line: from .commands import Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire\n  - Class Game(arena:Arena,tanks:dict[str,Tank]) validates unique in-bounds unblocked tank cells; deep-copies and stores an immutable initial arena/tank snapshot.\n  - Public mutable attributes: arena, tanks, projectiles, scores, command_queue, next_projectile_id.\n  - Methods:\n    - queue_command(self, player_id:str, command:Command)->None: enqueue without reordering.\n    - tick(self)->None: deterministic order: stable-sort queued commands by player id; dispatch solely with isinstance(command, MoveForward/RotateLeft/RotateRight/RotateTo/Fire); apply; clear queue; then process projectiles by pid ascending. Snapshot returns plain dict/list/scalars with Direction serialized via .name. Deterministic Game.tick applies queued commands with isinstance dispatch only, then moves projectiles in order during the same tick; reset restores deep initial clones and zeroed ScoreBoard with next_projectile_id=0.\n\nFull API specification (literal, exhaustive and aligned to the non-negotiable checklist):\n- Module tank_battle/directions.py:\n  - from enum import Enum; class Direction(Enum): with enum members exactly: N=(0,-1), E=(1,0), S=(0,1), W=(-1,0).\n  - Methods: delta(self)->tuple[int,int] returns self.value; left(self)->Direction returns enum member; right(self)->Direction returns enum member.\n- Module tank_battle/geometry.py:\n  - Class Rect(x:int,y:int,w:int,h:int): immutable value; raises ValueError if w<=0 or h<=0; method contains(px:int,py:int)->bool uses half-open cells x<=px<x+w and y<=py<y+h.\n- Module tank_battle/obstacle.py:\n  - Class Obstacle(rect:Rect) encapsulating one Rect. Provides its rect.\n- Module tank_battle/arena.py:\n  - Class Arena(width:int,height:int,obstacles:list[Obstacle]) rejects nonpositive dimensions; methods: in_bounds(x:int,y:int)->bool; is_blocked(x:int,y:int)->bool where out-of-bounds and any Obstacle cell are blocked.\n- Module tank_battle/tank.py:\n  - Class Tank(id:str,name:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,health:int=3,speed:int=1). Public attributes include direction.\n  - Methods: barrel_ahead()->tuple[int,int] using direction.delta(); alive()->bool; clone()->Tank deep copy.\n- Module tank_battle/projectile.py:\n  - Class Projectile(pid:int,owner_id:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,speed:int=1) with attribute direction.\n  - Methods: move()->None advances one unit using direction.delta(); clone()->Projectile deep copy.\n- Module tank_battle/commands.py:\n  - Class Command: instantiable marker; Command has no execute method; no ABC and no @abstractmethod.\n  - Subclasses: MoveForward(steps:int=1) rejects steps<1; RotateLeft(); RotateRight(); RotateTo(direction:Direction) stores attribute direction; Fire(). None defines execute.\n- Module tank_battle/scoring.py:\n  - Class ScoreBoard(player_ids:list[str]) immediately initializes hits and kills as {player_id:0 for player_id in player_ids}.\n  - Methods: record_hit(player_id:str)->None; record_kill(player_id:str)->None; score(player_id:str)->int defined as score(player_id)=hits+5*kills.\n- Module tank_battle/game.py:\n  - Must literally include the import line: from .commands import Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire\n  - Class Game(arena:Arena,tanks:dict[str,Tank]) validates unique in-bounds unblocked tank cells; deep-copies and stores an immutable initial arena/tank snapshot.\n  - Public mutable attributes: arena, tanks, projectiles, scores, command_queue, next_projectile_id.\n  - Methods:\n    - queue_command(self, player_id:str, command:Command)->None: enqueue without reordering.\n    - tick(self)->None: deterministic order: stable-sort queued commands by player id; dispatch solely with isinstance(command, MoveForward/RotateLeft/RotateRight/RotateTo/Fire); apply; clear queue; then process projectiles by pid ascending. MoveForward attempts one cell at a time and stops before bounds, obstacle, or a live tank. On Fire, if barrel_ahead is free, spawn a new Projectile at that cell with owner_id:str equal to the queuing tank id and pid=self.next_projectile_id then increment; in the same tick's projectile phase, every projectile including the new one moves by its speed one cell at a time; after each unit step, despawn on bounds/obstacle or if hitting the first non-owner live tank at that cell, reduce health by 1, call self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id) and, only when health becomes zero, call self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id), then remove the projectile.\n    - reset(self)->None: restore deep clones of the constructor-supplied initial arena and tanks (position, direction, health, speed), clear projectiles and command_queue, set scores=ScoreBoard(list(self._initial_tanks)), and next_projectile_id=0.\n    - winner(self)->str|None: returns the sole surviving tank id only when exactly one remains alive from at least two initial tanks; else None.\n    - snapshot(self)->dict: returns only plain dict/list/scalars; arena as dict, tanks as dict of dicts with direction serialized via .name, projectiles similarly, scores as a dict with hits, kills, and per-player score mapping, and winner as scalar id or None.\n- Module tank_battle/configs.py:\n  - build_default_demo()->Game: constructs exactly Arena(8,5,[]) and two tanks: Tank(\"p1\",\"P1\",1,2,Direction.E,3,1) and Tank(\"p2\",\"P2\",6,2,Direction.W,3,1); Snapshot returns plain dict/list/scalars with Direction serialized via .name. Deterministic Game.tick applies queued commands with isinstance dispatch only, then moves projectiles in order during the same tick; reset restores deep initial clones and zeroed ScoreBoard with next_projectile_id=0.\n\nFull API specification (literal, exhaustive and aligned to the non-negotiable checklist):\n- Module tank_battle/directions.py:\n  - from enum import Enum; class Direction(Enum): with enum members exactly: N=(0,-1), E=(1,0), S=(0,1), W=(-1,0).\n  - Methods: delta(self)->tuple[int,int] returns self.value; left(self)->Direction returns enum member; right(self)->Direction returns enum member.\n- Module tank_battle/geometry.py:\n  - Class Rect(x:int,y:int,w:int,h:int): immutable value; raises ValueError if w<=0 or h<=0; method contains(px:int,py:int)->bool uses half-open cells x<=px<x+w and y<=py<y+h.\n- Module tank_battle/obstacle.py:\n  - Class Obstacle(rect:Rect) encapsulating one Rect. Provides its rect.\n- Module tank_battle/arena.py:\n  - Class Arena(width:int,height:int,obstacles:list[Obstacle]) rejects nonpositive dimensions; methods: in_bounds(x:int,y:int)->bool; is_blocked(x:int,y:int)->bool where out-of-bounds and any Obstacle cell are blocked.\n- Module tank_battle/tank.py:\n  - Class Tank(id:str,name:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,health:int=3,speed:int=1). Public attributes include direction.\n  - Methods: barrel_ahead()->tuple[int,int] using direction.delta(); alive()->bool; clone()->Tank deep copy.\n- Module tank_battle/projectile.py:\n  - Class Projectile(pid:int,owner_id:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,speed:int=1) with attribute direction.\n  - Methods: move()->None advances one unit using direction.delta(); clone()->Projectile deep copy.\n- Module tank_battle/commands.py:\n  - Class Command: instantiable marker; Command has no execute method; no ABC and no @abstractmethod.\n  - Subclasses: MoveForward(steps:int=1) rejects steps<1; RotateLeft(); RotateRight(); RotateTo(direction:Direction) stores attribute direction; Fire(). None defines execute.\n- Module tank_battle/scoring.py:\n  - Class ScoreBoard(player_ids:list[str]) immediately initializes hits and kills as {player_id:0 for player_id in player_ids}.\n  - Methods: record_hit(player_id:str)->None; record_kill(player_id:str)->None; score(player_id:str)->int defined as score(player_id)=hits+5*kills.\n- Module tank_battle/game.py:\n  - Must literally include the import line: from .commands import Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire\n  - Class Game(arena:Arena,tanks:dict[str,Tank]) validates unique in-bounds unblocked tank cells; deep-copies and stores an immutable initial arena/tank snapshot.\n  - Public mutable attributes: arena, tanks, projectiles, scores, command_queue, next_projectile_id.\n  - Methods:\n    - queue_command(self, player_id:str, command:Command)->None: enqueue without reordering.\n    - tick(self)->None: deterministic order: stable-sort queued commands by player id; dispatch solely with isinstance(command, MoveForward/RotateLeft/RotateRight/RotateTo/Fire); apply; clear queue; then process projectiles by pid ascending. MoveForward attempts one cell at a time and stops before bounds, obstacle, or a live tank. On Fire, if barrel_ahead is free, spawn a new Projectile at that cell with owner_id:str equal to the queuing tank id and pid=self.next_projectile_id then increment; in the same tick's projectile phase, every projectile including the new one moves by its speed one cell at a time; after each unit step, despawn on bounds/obstacle or if hitting the first non-owner live tank at that cell, reduce health by 1, call self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id) and, only when health becomes zero, call self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id), then remove the projectile.\n    - reset(self)->None: restore deep clones of the constructor-supplied initial arena and tanks (position, direction, health, speed), clear projectiles and command_queue, set scores=ScoreBoard(list(self._initial_tanks)), and next_projectile_id=0.\n    - winner(self)->str|None: returns the sole surviving tank id only when exactly one remains alive from at least two initial tanks;   "Implementation approach": "Bob (Architect) designs a concise, medium-size Python 3.10 repository for a deterministic Tank battle game. Preserve protocol files exactly and keep Main.py thin. All reusable logic lives in a lowercase snake_case package tank_battle. Imports are acyclic: foundational modules (directions, geometry, obstacle) do not import engines or entrypoints. Snapshot returns plain dict/list/scalars with Direction serialized via .name. Deterministic Game.tick applies queued commands with isinstance dispatch only, then moves projectiles in order during the same tick; reset restores deep initial clones and zeroed ScoreBoard with next_projectile_id=0.\n\nFull API specification (literal, exhaustive and aligned to the non-negotiable checklist):\n- Module tank_battle/directions.py:\n  - from enum import Enum; class Direction(Enum): with enum members exactly: N=(0,-1), E=(1,0), S=(0,1), W=(-1,0).\n  - Methods: delta(self)->tuple[int,int] returns self.value; left(self)->Direction returns enum member; right(self)->Direction returns enum member.\n- Module tank_battle/geometry.py:\n  - Class Rect(x:int,y:int,w:int,h:int): immutable value; raises ValueError if w<=0 or h<=0; method contains(px:int,py:int)->bool uses half-open cells x<=px<x+w and y<=py<y+h.\n- Module tank_battle/obstacle.py:\n  - Class Obstacle(rect:Rect) encapsulating one Rect. Provides its rect.\n- Module tank_battle/arena.py:\n  - Class Arena(width:int,height:int,obstacles:list[Obstacle]) rejects nonpositive dimensions; methods: in_bounds(x:int,y:int)->bool; is_blocked(x:int,y:int)->bool where out-of-bounds and any Obstacle cell are blocked.\n- Module tank_battle/tank.py:\n  - Class Tank(id:str,name:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,health:int=3,speed:int=1). Public attributes include direction.\n  - Methods: barrel_ahead()->tuple[int,int] using direction.delta(); alive()->bool; clone()->Tank deep copy.\n- Module tank_battle/projectile.py:\n  - Class Projectile(pid:int,owner_id:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,speed:int=1) with attribute direction.\n  - Methods: move()->None advances one unit using direction.delta(); clone()->Projectile deep copy.\n- Module tank_battle/commands.py:\n  - Class Command: instantiable marker; Command has no execute method; no ABC and no @abstractmethod.\n  - Subclasses: MoveForward(steps:int=1) rejects steps<1; RotateLeft(); RotateRight(); RotateTo(direction:Direction) stores attribute direction; Fire(). None defines execute.\n- Module tank_battle/scoring.py:\n  - Class ScoreBoard(player_ids:list[str]) immediately initializes hits and kills as {player_id:0 for player_id in player_ids}.\n  - Methods: record_hit(player_id:str)->None; record_kill(player_id:str)->None; score(player_id:str)->int defined as score(player_id)=hits+5*kills.\n- Module tank_battle/game.py:\n  - Must literally include the import line: from .commands import Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire\n  - Class Game(arena:Arena,tanks:dict[str,Tank]) validates unique in-bounds unblocked tank cells; deep-copies and stores an immutable initial arena/tank snapshot.\n  - Public mutable attributes: arena, tanks, projectiles, scores, command_queue, next_projectile_id.\n  - Methods:\n    - queue_command(self, player_id:str, command:Command)->None: enqueue without reordering.\n    - tick(self)->None: deterministic order: stable-sort queued commands by player id; dispatch solely with isinstance(command, MoveForward/RotateLeft/RotateRight/RotateTo/Fire); apply; clear queue; then process projectiles by pid ascending. MoveForward attempts one cell at a time and stops before bounds, obstacle, or a live tank. On Fire, if barrel_ahead is free, spawn a new Projectile at that cell with owner_id:str equal to the queuing tank id and pid=self.next_projectile_id then increment; in the same tick's projectile phase, every projectile including the new one moves by its speed one cell at a time; after each unit step, despawn on bounds/obstacle or if hitting the first non-owner live tank at that cell, reduce health by 1, call self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id) and, only when health becomes zero, call self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id), then remove the projectile.\n    - reset(self)->None: restore deep clones of the constructor-supplied initial arena and tanks (position, direction, health, speed), clear projectiles and command_queue, set scores=ScoreBoard(list(self._initial_tanks)), and next_projectile_id=0.\n    - winner(self)->str|None: returns the sole surviving tank id only when exactly one remains alive from at least two initial tanks; else None.\n    - snapshot(self)->dict: returns only plain dict/list/scalars; arena as dict, tanks as dict of dicts with direction serialized via .name, projectiles similarly, scores as a dict with hits, kills, and per-player score mapping, and winner as scalar id or None.\n- Module tank_battle/configs.py:\n  - build_default_demo()->Game: constructs exactly Arena(8,5,[]) and two tanks: Tank(\"p1\",\"P1\",1,2,Direction.E,3,1) and Tank(\"p2\",\"P2\",6,2,Direction.W,3,1); builds Game and returns it.\n- Module tank_battle/__init__.py:\n  - Explicitly import and re-export exactly these public symbols: Game, Arena, Obstacle, Rect, Tank, Projectile, ScoreBoard, Direction, Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire, and build_default_demo; __all__ lists those exact names; no wildcard imports and no nested aliases such as Game.Arena; no package attribute named commands.\n- Module Main.py:\n  - from tank_battle import build_default_demo, RotateRight\n  - Function run_demo()->dict: constructs game=build_default_demo(); literally calls game.queue_command(\"p1\", RotateRight()) with a command instance (not the string \"RotateRight\"), then calls game.tick() exactly once, returns game.snapshot(). main() prints that snapshot and is called under if __name__==\"__main__\".\n\nDeterministic fixtures (repeat verbatim):\n- Arena(8,5,[])\n- Tank(\"p1\",\"P1\",1,2,Direction.E,3,1)\n- Tank(\"p2\",\"P2\",6,2,Direction.W,3,1)\n\nProjectile same-tick movement rule: Fire first creates a projectile at barrel_ahead; tick one therefore leaves it at (3,2); tick two moves it to (4,2) and hits p2. A test expecting (2,2) after tick one is forbidden.\n\nScoring call literals: self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id) and self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id) on kill only.\n\nWinner rule: winner returns the sole surviving tank id only when exactly one remains alive from at least two initial tanks.\n\nReset fixture rule: capture initial snapshot immediately after Game construction with no queued Fire and no tick; after manipulating state, reset() must restore deep clones and zeroed scores as {\"p1\":0,\"p2\":0}; next_projectile_id==0.\n\nImport graph policy: foundational modules never import engines or entrypoints; game.py directly imports command classes via the literal line; __init__.py only re-exports public symbols; Main.py imports only build_default_demo and RotateRight.\n\nImplementation Task List (dependency-first order):\n1) requirements.txt — list pytest only.\n2) tank_battle/directions.py — implement Direction exactly with from enum import Enum; class Direction(Enum): N=(0,-1), E=(1,0), S=(0,1), W=(-1,0); delta/left/right methods.\n3) tank_battle/geometry.py — immutable Rect with validation and contains() half-open rule.\n4) tank_battle/obstacle.py — Obstacle wrapping one Rect.\n5) tank_battle/arena.py — Arena with bounds and obstacle blocking.\n6) tank_battle/tank.py — Tank with barrel_ahead(), alive(), and clone().\n7) tank_battle/projectile.py — Projectile with move() using direction.delta() and clone().\n8) tank_battle/commands.py — Command marker; {"Implementation approach":"Bob (Architect) designs a concise, medium-size Python 3.10 repository for a deterministic Tank battle game. Preserve protocol files exactly and keep Main.py thin. All reusable logic lives in a lowercase snake_case package tank_battle. Imports are acyclic: foundational modules (directions, geometry, obstacle) do not import engines or entrypoints. Snapshot returns plain dict/list/scalars with Direction serialized via .name. Deterministic Game.tick applies queued commands with isinstance dispatch only, then moves projectiles in order during the same tick; reset restores deep initial clones and zeroed ScoreBoard with next_projectile_id=0.

Full API specification (literal, exhaustive and aligned to the non-negotiable checklist):
- Module tank_battle/directions.py:
  - from enum import Enum; class Direction(Enum): with enum members exactly: N=(0,-1), E=(1,0), S=(0,1), W=(-1,0).
  - Methods: delta(self)->tuple[int,int] returns self.value; left(self)->Direction returns enum member; right(self)->Direction returns enum member.
- Module tank_battle/geometry.py:
  - Class Rect(x:int,y:int,w:int,h:int): immutable value; raises ValueError if w<=0 or h<=0; method contains(px:int,py:int)->bool uses half-open cells x<=px<x+w and y<=py<y+h.
- Module tank_battle/obstacle.py:
  - Class Obstacle(rect:Rect) encapsulating one Rect. Provides its rect.
- Module tank_battle/arena.py:
  - Class Arena(width:int,height:int,obstacles:list[Obstacle]) rejects nonpositive dimensions; methods: in_bounds(x:int,y:int)->bool; is_blocked(x:int,y:int)->bool where out-of-bounds and any Obstacle cell are blocked.
- Module tank_battle/tank.py:
  - Class Tank(id:str,name:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,health:int=3,speed:int=1). Public attributes include direction.
  - Methods: barrel_ahead()->tuple[int,int] using direction.delta(); alive()->bool; clone()->Tank deep copy.
- Module tank_battle/projectile.py:
  - Class Projectile(pid:int,owner_id:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,speed:int=1) with attribute direction.
  - Methods: move()->None advances one unit using direction.delta(); clone()->Projectile deep copy.
- Module tank_battle/commands.py:
  - Class Command: instantiable marker; Command has no execute method; no ABC and no @abstractmethod.
  - Subclasses: MoveForward(steps:int=1) rejects steps<1; RotateLeft(); RotateRight(); RotateTo(direction:Direction) stores attribute direction; Fire(). None defines execute.
- Module tank_battle/scoring.py:
  - Class ScoreBoard(player_ids:list[str]) immediately initializes hits and kills as {player_id:0 for player_id in player_ids}.
  - Methods: record_hit(player_id:str)->None; record_kill(player_id:str)->None; score(player_id:str)->int defined as score(player_id)=hits+5*kills.
- Module tank_battle/game.py:
  - Must literally include the import line: from .commands import Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire
  - Class Game(arena:Arena,tanks:dict[str,Tank]) validates unique in-bounds unblocked tank cells; deep-copies and stores an immutable initial arena/tank snapshot.
  - Public mutable attributes: arena, tanks, projectiles, scores, command_queue, next_projectile_id.
  - Methods:
    - queue_command(self, player_id:str, command:Command)->None: enqueue without reordering.
    - tick(self)->None: deterministic order: stable-sort queued commands by player id; dispatch solely with isinstance(command, MoveForward/RotateLeft/RotateRight/RotateTo/Fire); apply; clear queue; then process projectiles by pid ascending. MoveForward attempts one cell at a time and stops before bounds, obstacle, or a live tank. On Fire, if barrel_ahead is free, spawn a new Projectile at that cell with owner_id:str equal to the queuing tank id and pid=self.next_projectile_id then increment; in the same tick's projectile phase, every projectile including the new one moves by its speed one cell at a time; after each unit step, despawn on bounds/obstacle or if hitting the first non-owner live tank at that cell, reduce health by 1, call self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id) and, only when health becomes zero, call self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id), then remove the projectile.
    - reset(self)->None: restore deep clones of the constructor-supplied initial arena and tanks (position, direction, health, speed), clear projectiles and command_queue, set scores=ScoreBoard(list(self._initial_tanks)), and next_projectile_id=0.
    - winner(self)->str|None: returns the sole surviving tank id only when exactly one remains alive from at least two initial tanks; else None.
    - snapshot(self)->dict: returns only plain dict/list/scalars; arena as dict, tanks as dict of dicts with direction serialized via .name, projectiles similarly, scores as a dict with hits, kills, and per-player score mapping, and winner as scalar id or None.
- Module tank_battle/configs.py:
  - build_default_demo()->Game: constructs exactly Arena(8,5,[]) and two tanks: Tank("p1","P1",1,2,Direction.E,3,1) and Tank("p2","P2",6,2,Direction.W,3,1); builds Game and returns it.
- Module tank_battle/__init__.py:
  - Explicitly import and re-export exactly these public symbols: Game, Arena, Obstacle, Rect, Tank, Projectile, ScoreBoard, Direction, Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire, and build_default_demo; __all__ lists those exact names; no wildcard imports and no nested aliases such as Game.Arena; no package attribute named commands.
- Module Main.py:
  - from tank_battle import build_default_demo, RotateRight
  - Function run_demo()->dict: constructs game=build_default_demo(); literally calls game.queue_command("p1", RotateRight()) with a command instance (not the string "RotateRight"), then calls game.tick() exactly once, returns game.snapshot(). main() prints that snapshot and is called under if __name__=="__main__".

- Arena(8,5,[])
- Tank("p1","P1",1,2,Direction.E,3,1)
- Tank("p2","P2",6,2,Direction.W,3,1)

Scoring call literals: self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id) and self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id) on kill only.

Winner rule: winner returns the sole surviving tank id only when exactly one remains alive from at least two initial tanks.

Reset fixture rule: capture initial snapshot immediately after Game construction with no queued Fire and no tick; after manipulating state, reset() must restore deep clones and zeroed scores as {"p1":0,"p2":0}; next_projectile_id==0.

  - Subclasses:

    - RotateLeft(): no arguments
    - RotateRight(): no arguments
    - RotateTo(direction:Direction): stores attribute direction
    - Fire(): no arguments
  - None of these defines execute; polymorphic callbacks are forbidden.

- Module tank_battle/scoring.py:

  - Methods:

  - Must literally include: from .commands import Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire
  - Class Game(arena:Arena,tanks:dict[str,Tank])

      - every tank has a unique (x,y)
      - all tank cells are in-bounds and unblocked by obstacles
      - stores deep immutable initial snapshot of arena and tanks
    - Public mutable attributes: arena, tanks, projectiles, scores, command_queue, next_projectile_id
    - queue_command(self, player_id:str, command:Command)->None: appends (player_id,command) to command_queue without reordering
    - tick(self)->None: deterministic order
      - stable-sort queued commands by player id
      - dispatch solely with isinstance(command, MoveForward/RotateLeft/RotateRight/RotateTo/Fire); command.execute or any other polymorphic call is forbidden
      - Apply commands:
        - MoveForward: attempt steps one cell at a time; stop before moving into out-of-bounds, obstacle, or a live tank cell
        - RotateLeft/RotateRight: change direction accordingly
        - RotateTo: set tank.direction to given direction
        - Fire: if barrel_ahead is free (in-bounds, not obstacle, not occupied by a live tank), spawn Projectile(pid=self.next_projectile_id, owner_id=player_id, x,y=barrel cell, direction=tank.direction), increment next_projectile_id
      - Clear command_queue after applying
      - Process projectiles by pid ascending. For each projectile, move by speed one unit at a time within the same tick; after each unit step:

    - reset(self)->None: restore deep clones of the constructor-supplied initial arena and tanks (position, direction, health, speed), clear projectiles and command_queue, set scores=ScoreBoard(list(self._initial_tanks)), and next_projectile_id=0
    - winner(self)->str|None: returns the sole surviving tank id only when exactly one remains alive from at least two initial tanks; else None
    - snapshot(self)->dict: returns only plain dict/list/scalars; arena as dict, tanks as dict of dicts with direction serialized via .name, projectiles similarly, scores as a dict with hits, kills, and per-player score mapping, and winner as scalar id or None
  - Scoring calls must be exactly: self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id) and self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id) on kill only.

All reusable logic lives in a lowercase snake_case package tank_battle. Imports are acyclic: foundational modules (directions, geometry, obstacle) do not import engines or entrypoints. Snapshot returns plain dict/list/scalars with Direction serialized via .name. Deterministic Game.tick applies queued commands with isinstance dispatch only, then moves projectiles in order during the same tick; reset restores deep initial clones and zeroed ScoreBoard with next_projectile_id=0.

Full API specification (literal, exhaustive and aligned to the non-negotiable checklist):
- Module tank_battle/directions.py:
  - from enum import Enum; class Direction(Enum): with enum members exactly: N=(0,-1), E=(1,0), S=(0,1), W=(-1,0).
  - Methods: delta(self)->tuple[int,int] returns self.value; left(self)->Direction returns enum member; right(self)->Direction returns enum member.
- Module tank_battle/geometry.py:
  - Class Rect(x:int,y:int,w:int,h:int): immutable value; raises ValueError if w<=0 or h<=0; method contains(px:int,py:int)->bool uses half-open cells x<=px<x+w and y<=py<y+h.
- Module tank_battle/obstacle.py:
  - Class Obstacle(rect:Rect) encapsulating one Rect. Provides its rect.
- Module tank_battle/arena.py:
  - Class Arena(width:int,height:int,obstacles:list[Obstacle]) rejects nonpositive dimensions; methods: in_bounds(x:int,y:int)->bool; is_blocked(x:int,y:int)->bool where out-of-bounds and any Obstacle cell are blocked.
- Module tank_battle/tank.py:
  - Class Tank(id:str,name:str,x:int,y:int,direction:Direction,health:int=3,speed:int=1). Public attributes include direction.
  - Methods: barrel_ahead()->tuple[int,int] using direction.delta(); alive()->bool; clone()->Tank deep copy.
- Module tank_battle/projectile.py:

  - Methods: move()->None advances one unit using direction.delta(); clone()->Projectile deep copy.
- Module tank_battle/commands.py:
  - Class Command: instantiable marker; Command has no execute method; no ABC and no @abstractmethod.
  - Subclasses: MoveForward(steps:int=1) rejects steps<1; RotateLeft(); RotateRight(); RotateTo(direction:Direction) stores attribute direction; Fire(). None defines execute.
- Module tank_battle/scoring.py:

  - Methods: record_hit(player_id:str)->None; record_kill(player_id:str)->None; score(player_id:str)->int defined as score(player_id)=hits+5*kills.
- Module tank_battle/game.py:
  - Must literally include the import line: from .commands import Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire
  - Class Game(arena:Arena,tanks:dict[str,Tank]) validates unique in-bounds unblocked tank cells; deep-copies and stores an immutable initial arena/tank snapshot.
  - Public mutable attributes: arena, tanks, projectiles, scores, command_queue, next_projectile_id.
  - Methods:
    - queue_command(self, player_id:str, command:Command)->None: enqueue without reordering.
    - tick(self)->None: deterministic order: stable-sort queued commands by player id; dispatch solely with isinstance(command, MoveForward/RotateLeft/RotateRight/RotateTo/Fire); apply; clear queue; then process projectiles by pid ascending. MoveForward attempts one cell at a time and stops before bounds, obstacle, or a live tank. On Fire, if barrel_ahead is free, spawn a new Projectile at that cell with owner_id:str equal to the queuing tank id and pid=self.next_projectile_id then increment; in the same tick's projectile phase, every projectile including the new one moves by its speed one cell at a time; after each unit step, despawn on bounds/obstacle or if hitting the first non-owner live tank at that cell, reduce health by 1, call self.scores.record_hit(projectile.owner_id) and, only when health becomes zero, call self.scores.record_kill(projectile.owner_id), then remove the projectile.
    - reset(self)->None: restore deep clones of the constructor-supplied initial arena and tanks (position, direction, health, speed), clear projectiles and command_queue, set scores=ScoreBoard(list(self._initial_tanks)), and next_projectile_id=0.
    - winner(self)->str|None: returns the sole surviving tank id only when exactly one remains alive from at least two initial tanks; else None.
    - snapshot(self)->dict: returns only plain dict/list/scalars; arena as dict, tanks as dict of dicts with direction serialized via .name, projectiles similarly, scores as a dict with hits, kills, and per-player score mapping, and winner as scalar id or None.
- Module tank_battle/configs.py:
  - build_default_demo()->Game: constructs exactly Arena(8,5,[]) and two tanks: Tank("p1","P1",1,2,Direction.E,3,1) and Tank("p2","P2",6,2,Direction.W,3,1); builds Game and returns it.
- Module tank_battle/__init__.py:
  - Explicitly import and re-export exactly these public symbols: Game, Arena, Obstacle, Rect, Tank, Projectile, ScoreBoard, Direction, Command, MoveForward, RotateLeft, RotateRight, RotateTo, Fire, and build_default_demo; __all__ lists those exact names; no wildcard imports and no nested aliases such as Game.Arena; no package attribute named commands.
- Module Main.py:
  - from tank_battle import build_default_demo, RotateRight
  - Function run_demo()->dict: constructs game=build_default_demo(); literally calls game.queue_command("p1", RotateRight()) with a command instance (not the string "RotateRight"), then calls game.tick() exactly once, returns game.snapshot(). main() prints that snapshot and is called under if __name__=="__main__".

- Tank("p2","P2",6,2,Direction.W,3,1)
